senses.definition_en: To interpret a word or action in a particular way.
senses.explanation_ar: تفهم أو تفسر كلام أو تصرف بطريقة معينة.
examples: How should I construe your remark about my performance?
It is easy to construe his silence as an admission of guilt.
The judge had to construe the ambiguous clause in the contract.
